svg.text: DRY BULK DENSITY · MG PER CUBIC METRE
CLAY LOAM AT THE AASHTO PEAK A SIDEWALK SUB-BASE IS BUILT TO

Grabosky, Bassuk and von Es 1996; Grabosky 1995. Check against the 1997 erratum before printing.
